summary: Warnings for Ramelteon include severe allergic reactions, such as rapid swelling under the skin called angioedema and full-body allergic reactions called anaphylaxis [3]. Other warnings note that patients should be evaluated for other conditions if sleeplessness lasts beyond 7 to 10 days, alongside precautions for abnormal thinking and behavioral changes [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug low scores for liver and heart risks [M].
